newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks hold on to gains to end near highs.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks hold on to gains to end near highs.

text.p: Madrid stock indices held on to gains to close near session highs on Wednesday ahead of the quarter end, buoyed by strength in a handful of leading shares.
The general index rose 6.27 points, 1.32 percent, to 480.57 while the Ibex-35 index of leading shares climbed 81.92 points, 1.51 percent, to 5,520.68.
"We are surprised by this strength, especially since Wall Street opened lower," one dealer said, attributing the rise to strength in a number of leading shares.

Telefonica attracted most interest and accounted for 36 percent of volume thanks to a number of block trades and a put-through order of some five million shares. Telefonica closed 45 pesetas higher at 3,495.
Traders said the market was somewhat relieved after the U.S had raised short-term rates by 25 basis points, and nervousness seen in previous sessions had dissipated.
Traders said quarter-end trade may also have lifted the market. However, they added that it was too soon to say whether the market had resumed an upward trend.
Repsol also accounted for a high percentage of volume, rising 130 pesetas to 6,030.
Traders said total volume had been high with 103 billion shares changing hands.
